:::{#hero-heading}

Thanks for stopping by! 

I am Richard Liu and I am supervised by [Dr. Ivan Diaz](https://idiaz.xyz/) during my Ph.D. experience. I have also maintained working relationships with [Dr. Wenbo Wu](https://www.wenbowu.me/), [Dr. Michele Santacatterina](https://michelesantacatterina.github.io/), and [Dr. Alex Luedtke](https://alexluedtke.com/). 

My research work has been focusing on causal machine learning, semiparametric theories, mediation analysis, and causal inference with time-varying treatment/outcome. I am generally interested in developing/applying modern statistical methodologoies such that they can be useful in other fields related to public health or medicine. 

Please feel free to reach out for any potential collaborations! 

## Education

- PhD, NYU Grossman School of Medicine, Expected 2027
